King Abdulaziz bin Abdulrahman Al Saud Mosque in the city of Mansehra is a gift from the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia to the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, following the devastating earthquake that struck parts of Pakistan on October 8, 2005.
Description
The mosque is located within the campus of Hazara University in Mansehra, covering a total area of approximately 41,000 square meters. It consists of the main mosque building and adjacent prayer spaces, accommodating more than 10,000 worshippers. Additionally, the complex includes residences for the imam and the muezzin, service facilities, public gardens, and parking areas. The architectural design incorporates Islamic elements and is inspired by the design of the Masjid al-Haram in Mecca.
